name: Samaias
description: Called "that great Samaias" by Tobit; father of Ananias the great and Jonathas, kinsmen of Tobit whom Raphael invoked (falsely, as part of his disguise as Azarias) when claiming descent from Ananias

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
